basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Software Engineer, Core Platform · Generalist (Backend/Infra/Data) · Agent Orchestration & AI Tooling · 9,300★ OSS Contributor · 3.5+ Years

summaries.shipsy-core-platform: Software Engineer, Core Platform with 3.5+ years of production engineering experience and expertise across backend, infra, and data — Go, Python, distributed systems, and AI-agent orchestration. Built a production multi-agent orchestration system and the Steampipe MCP server from scratch at Turbot HQ (9,300+ GitHub stars, 120+ merged PRs), and lifted a Go-based CLI's throughput 30% to 1,000+ events per second.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Designed and built a multi-agent orchestration system on the OpenAI Agents SDK end to end — a 0→1 build — where LLM agents generate cloud policy commands, validate them in a live environment, self-correct failures, and score outcomes against an internal metric.

Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, designing the interface from scratch to give LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, test generation, deployment, and PR creation — using AI as leverage to automate my own workflow; used it to migrate 35+ Azure modules to event-driven eventing, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.

Owned the design, build, testing, and deployment of an internal REST API microservice in Go (Gin) as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails; secured with OAuth 2.0 via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for internal microservices.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ events per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures at scale.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
Owned release engineering end-to-end for four open-source Go CLIs — unified GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows and GHCR Docker image tagging, establishing engineering best practices across the platform.
